tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: 'od dpag med tshe sgrub kyi cha lag tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i lcags kyu gsang ba'i yang snying bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa he ru ka thams cad kyi rigs kyi bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000250 yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas tshe 'gugs pa'i thabs bstan pa ni: sbyor dngos gnyis las: dang po sbyor ba ni: mda' dar kha dog lnga rigs lnga'i 'brang rgyas la gzug: dung: g.yu:1$0000300 sku rten/ 1$0000250 gser: dngul:1$0000300 yon tan rten/ 1$0000250mu men:1$0000300 thugs rten/ 1$0000250bye ru:1$0000300 gsung rten/ 1$0000250khrab byang mig dgu:1$0000300 phrin las rten/ 1$0000250gzhan yan lag gi rten du gser thig: mu tig: za 'og: stag ras: gzig ras: sman sna dang dri bzang gi thum bu: mchong: gzi mig dgu'am gzi phal pa: spos shel: shel dkar: man shel: padma rā ga: dkar phra men: spug: 'ching bu: ma na ho:1$0000300 1$0000250pha bong long bu: mgron bu: dar sna'i lce'u lnga: le brgan dmar po: thog lcags sogs gdags la: tshe'i rten du bzung: gta' gtor rkang gcig gi dbus su 'byung lnga'i gtor ma'am: dbus su gtor ma gcig la tshe ril gyis bkang bar bshams la:1$0000300 gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni: mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs gyer ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dbus nas rang byung tshe yi lha: bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med: 'chi med bcom ldan tshe dpag med: gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar mo: sprul sku rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs: yang sprul sems dpa' sems ma ste: yab yum sprul 'khor yang sprul sogs: khro bo dbang chen he ru ka: khro mo gzi ldan ral gcig ma: sras dang sprul pa khro bo bcu: yang sprul grangs med bka' nyan te: sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rtags gsal: rgyan cha rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams nas: bdag cag bla tshe myur du khug: steng phyogs nyi zla'i lag nas tshe khug la:

'og phyogs sa bdag lag nas bla srog khug: tshe khug bla khug dpal skyed cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di brtan par mdzod: hūm̐: shar nas rang byung tshe yi lha: tshe lha'i mtshan ni rdo rje sems: rig ma'i mtshan ni sangs rgyas spyan/ sems dpa' sa snying byams pa dkar: sems ma lā se puṣpe dkar: khro bo chen po khams gsum rgyal: dbyug pa sngon po 'jigs pa'i gzugs: khro mo gtsug tor sder mo gnyis: ma mo kau'u ri puska sī: phra men siṃ ha bya rgod gdong: dbang phyug dkar mo ma bdun bcas: mgyogs ma sgo ma 'khor dang bcas: sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rtags la: rgyan phreng rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: shar phyogs 'jig rten khams dkrugs la: dri za'i lag nas tshe khug la: me lha'i lag nas bla srog khug: tshe khug bla khug dpal skyed cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di brtan par mdzod: hūm̐: lho nas rang byung tshe yi lha: rin chen 'byung ldan tshe dpag med: mā ma kī dang gnyis med 'khril: sems dpa' kun bzang nam snying mthing: sems ma mā le dhū pe ma: khro bo gshin rje mi g.yo mgon: khro mo ral gcig gtun khung ma: ma mo tso'u rī kasma rī: phra men stag gdong kang ka'i gdong: dbang phyug ser mo sring mo bdun: mgyogs ma sgo ma 'khor dang bcas: sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rtags la: rgyan phreng rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: lho phyogs 'jig rten khams dkrugs la: gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug la: srin po'i lag nas bla srog khug: tshe khug bla khug dpal skyed cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di brtan par mdzod: hūm̐: nub nas rang byung tshe yi lha: snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: gos dkar mo dang gnyis med 'khril: sems dpa' spyan gzigs 'jam dpal dmar: sems ma gī tī ā lo ke: khro bo rta mgrin 'dod pa'i rgyal: khro mo phag mo mda' snyems ma: ma mo pra mo tsandha lī: phra men wa gdong bya rog gdong: dbang phyug dmar mo mdza' mo bdun:

mgyogs ma sgo ma 'khor dang bcas: sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rtags la: rgyan phreng rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: nub phyogs 'jig rten khams dkrugs la: klu gdon lag nas tshe khug la: rlung lha'i lag nas bla srog khug: tshe khug bla khug srog skyobs shig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di brtan par mdzod: hūm̐: byang nas rang byung tshe yi lha: don yod grub pa tshe dpag med: dam tshig sgrol dang gnyis med 'khril: sems dpa' sgrib sel phyag rdor ljang: sems ma gandhe nīrtī ma: khro bo bdud rtsi stobs po che: khro mo rlung 'byin skyod byed ma: ma mo bai ta sma sha ni: phra men spyang gdong 'ug gdong ma: dbang phyug ljang mo bran mo bdun: mgyogs ma sgo ma 'khor dang bcas: sku mdog phyag mtshan rang rtags la: rgyan phreng rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: byang phyogs 'jig rten khams dkrugs la: gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug cig: dbang ldan lag nas bla srog khug: tshe khug bla khug srog skyobs shig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di brtan par mdzod: ces dkyil 'khor gyi lha zhi drag gnyis med la phrin las bcol ba'o: : gu hya: gnyis pa tshe yi las byed lha mo rnams bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: yi dam rta mchog he ru ka'i: bka' nyan las byed lha mo'i tshogs: nam mkha' stong la dbang sgyur cing: ri rab kun la rgyab brten nas: 'byung ba kun la mnga' brnyes pa'i: srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur ba'i: tshe yi lha mo rgyud 'phel ma: shar zla 'od dkar po'i dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje dkar mo spyan phran 'bum: phyag g.yas tshe dpal mda' dar bsnams: phyag g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: bum pa'i nang yang tshe yis bkang: bum pa'i nang yang g.yang gis bkang: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam shing: bum pa'i gzungs thag lu gu rgyud: lu gu rgyud kyang rdo rje'i phreng: bdag cag rnams la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: phywa khug tshe khug g.yang khug cig:

tshe yi snying po a dkar dang: mi yi snying po nṛ ljang gu: bum par stims la rgya yis thobs: mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi gter: mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi gter: mi nub rgyal mtshan tshe yi gter: mi zad rin chen tshe yi gter: tshe gter rgya dang bcas pa 'di: tshe rta zhi khro'i thugs la sba: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: tshe mchog dbang gi byin phob la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur zhing: ri rab kun la rgyab brten nas: 'byung ba kun la mnga' brnyes shing: srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur ba'i: tshe yi lha mo rgyud 'phel ma: lho zla 'od ser po'i dkyil 'khor du: rin chen ser mo spyan phran 'bum: phyag g.yas tshe dpal mda' dar bsnams: phyag g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: bum pa'i nang yang tshe yis bkang: bum pa'i nang yang g.yang gis bkang: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam shing: bum pa'i gzungs thag lu gu rgyud: lu gu rgyud kyang rin chen phreng: bdag cag rnams la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: phya khug tshe khug g.yang khug cig: tshe yi snying po a dkar dang: mi yi snying po nṛ ljang gu: bum par stims la rgya yis thobs: mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi gter: mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi gter: mi nub rgyal mtshan tshe yi gter: mi zad rin chen tshe yi gter: tshe gter rgya dang bcas pa 'di: tshe rta zhi khro'i thugs la sba: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: tshe mchog dbang gi byin phob la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur zhing: ri rab kun la rgyab rten nas: 'byung ba kun la mnga' brnyes shing: srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i: tshe yi lha mo rgyud 'phel ma: nub zla 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du:

padma dmar mo spyan phran 'bum: phyag g.yas tshe dpal mda' dar bsnams: phyag g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: bum pa'i nang yang tshe yis bkang: bum pa'i nang yang g.yang gis bkang: bum pa'i kha rgyan dpag bsam shing: bum pa'i gzungs thag lu gu rgyud: lu gu rgyud kyang padma'i phreng: bdag cag rnams la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: phywag khug g.yang khug tshe khug cig: tshe yi snying po a dkar dang: mi yi snying po nṛ ljang gu: bum par stims la rgya yis thobs: mi 'gyur g.yung drung tshe yi gter: mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi gter: mi nub rgyal mtshan tshe yi gter: mi zad rin chen tshe yi gter: tshe gter rgya dang bcas pa 'di: tshe rta zhi khro'i thugs la sba: thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: tshe mchog dbang gi byin phob la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ces tshe 'gugs shing dmigs pas bstim pa'o: tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i lcags kyu lha mo tsandha lī'i gsungs ltar padmas bkod pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: : gu hya: mant+ra: su tan: stag sham nus ldan rdo rjes so// //
